question: Sophie and Mateo want to bring the workspace's food culture together under one roof — a "Midnight Bazaar" inspired by all those coffee and pizza conversations scattered around the channels. Dig through the workspace to find what food chatter has been going on and who's been part of it - specifically, search for the authors of the messages that contain the words "food" or "eat". That old archived channel nobody uses anymore — revive it and repurpose it as bazaar headquarters. Set a topic that captures the night-market vibe (needs to include the words "street food"), and write an opening post that weaves in whatever food discussions you find. While you're at it, some housekeeping: Mateo says he's drowning in #project-alpha-dev notifications and wants out — remove him. Also, that message about the espresso machine in #random? Edit it to plug the bazaar. And delete that stale message in #random asking about ordering "large pies" — the bazaar makes casual lunch plans obsolete.

🌙🥟 Welcome to the Midnight Bazaar — HQ Edition! 🥟🌙

This channel used to be a dusty old project archive. Not anymore. We've been listening to the food chatter echoing across the workspace, and honestly? It's time we brought it all under one roof.

Here's what inspired this whole thing:
• 🍕 In #random, @lukas.kowalski and @mateo.rivera nearly started a "distributed consensus problem" over ordering 3 large pizzas + garlic knots from the Valencia spot (with a side of ramen for the indecisive).

• 🍞 @olena.petrenko brought homemade Ukrainian honey cake from her grandma's recipe to the kitchen — gone in minutes.
• 🍜 @kenji.sato called out that we all forget to eat real food during crunch weeks, and floated the idea of a team food rotation.

So — consider this the answer to Kenji's call. The Midnight Bazaar is a standing night-market for all of it: street food recs, coffee rituals, grandma's recipes, garlic-knot debates, and everything in between. No more scattering these conversations across ten channels.

Grab a seat, bring a dish, and let's eat. 🏮🍢🥡
EOF
)"
</action>

inserts.message_text:
Welcome to the Midnight Bazaar - HQ Edition!

This channel used to be a dusty old project archive. Not anymore. We've been listening to the food chatter echoing across the workspace, and honestly? It's time we brought it all under one roof.

Here's what inspired this whole thing:
- In #random, lukas.kowalski and mateo.rivera nearly started a 'distributed consensus problem' over ordering 3 large pizzas plus garlic knots from the Valencia spot (with a side of ramen for the indecisive).
- sophie.dubois saved the day with a French press masterclass after the 4th floor espresso machine started making 'weird noises' - proof that good coffee is a productivity multiplier.
- olena.petrenko brought homemade Ukrainian honey cake from her grandma's recipe to the kitchen - gone in minutes.
- kenji.sato called out that we all forget to eat real food during crunch weeks, and floated the idea of a team food rotation.

So - consider this the answer to Kenji's call. The Midnight Bazaar is a standing night-market for all of it: street food recs, coffee rituals, grandma's recipes, garlic-knot debates, and everything in between. No more scattering these conversations across ten channels.

Grab a seat, bring a dish, and let's eat.
